title: Thu 08 Oct 2026: Fed minutes hawkish, 30-year gilt tops 6%, FCA transaction reporting consultation, crypto perimeter guidance final
summary: Wall Street's record run pauses as the ten-year Treasury yield hits its highest since 2002 after hawkish Fed minutes, and the 30-year gilt yield tops six percent for the first time since 1998, with Brent back near one hundred dollars. The FCA consults on transaction reporting (CP26/34) and finalises crypto perimeter guidance (PS26/18). Plus fund industry notes, three COO action points and the week's diary.
